notes.title: Super XYX - GMS2 Port Beta Test
notes.content:
Welcome to the public test of the new Super XYX build, the game has been ported to Game Maker Studio 2.x and now are ensuring it all works properly before it becomes the new, main version.

This hopefully will help resolve remaining technical problems you might have encountered in the previous version. We have also added the following to the game:

* You can now practice stages that you complete
* There is a new, unlockable ship, can you spot it and tell us whether it's overpowered or perfectly balanced?
